local drag_route = nil
local native_peer = nil
local native_timer = nil
local native_last_x, native_last_y = nil, nil
local native_ticks = 0
local pearl_kinds = { Launcher = true, Dashboard = true, AI = true, Controls = true, Media = true }
local function native_event(phase, cursor)
    if not native_peer then return end
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.event("nacre_pearl_drag," .. phase .. "," .. native_peer.title .. "," .. cursor.x .. "," .. cursor.y .. "," .. native_peer.x .. "," .. native_peer.y .. "," .. native_peer.w .. "," .. native_peer.h))
end
local function watch_native_drag()
    if not native_peer or native_peer.pid ~= nacre_panel_pid or native_ticks >= 3600 then
        native_timer:set_enabled(false)
        native_peer = nil
        return
    end
    native_ticks = native_ticks + 1
    local cursor = hl.get_cursor_pos()
    if cursor.x ~= native_last_x or cursor.y ~= native_last_y then
        native_last_x, native_last_y = cursor.x, cursor.y
        native_event("move", cursor)
    end
end
local function start_native_drag()
    local result = hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.drag())
    local window = hl.get_active_window()
    local kind = window and window.title:match("^Nacre Pearl (%a+) %d+$")
    if window and window.pid == nacre_panel_pid and pearl_kinds[kind] then
        local at, size = window.at, window.size
        native_peer = { title = window.title, pid = window.pid, x = at.x, y = at.y, w = size.x, h = size.y }
        native_ticks = 0
        native_last_x, native_last_y = nil, nil
        native_event("begin", hl.get_cursor_pos())
        if not native_timer then
            native_timer = hl.timer(watch_native_drag, { timeout = 33, type = "repeat" })
        else
            native_timer:set_enabled(true)
        end
    end
    return result
end
-- A layer drag never calls window.drag(), so Hyprland 0.56 does not arm
-- its implicit release callback. Finish explicitly on every LMB release,
-- including a release after Super has already been let go. Native movement
-- itself ends in Hyprland's mouse handler before these callbacks run.
local function nacre_panel_drag_finish()
    local shell = drag_route
    drag_route = nil
    if native_peer then native_event("end", hl.get_cursor_pos()) end
    native_peer = nil
    if native_timer then native_timer:set_enabled(false) end
    return { ok = true, pass_event = shell ~= false }
end
local function nacre_panel_drag()
    -- Native window.drag() also asks Hyprland to call this on release. The
    -- explicit release binding below is idempotent if both callbacks run.
    if drag_route ~= nil then return nacre_panel_drag_finish() end
    local cursor = hl.get_cursor_pos()
    local shell = false
    for _, layer in ipairs(hl.get_layers()) do
        if layer.namespace == "nacre-drawers" and layer.mapped and layer.pid == nacre_panel_pid then
            for _, rect in ipairs(nacre_panel_regions or {}) do
                if cursor.x >= rect.x and cursor.y >= rect.y and cursor.x < rect.x + rect.w and cursor.y < rect.y + rect.h then
                    shell = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if shell then break end
    end
    drag_route = shell
    if shell then return { ok = true, pass_event = true } end
    return start_native_drag()
end
hl.bind("SUPER + mouse:272", nacre_panel_drag, {description="Nacre:move-panel-or-window"})
hl.bind("mouse:272", nacre_panel_drag_finish, {release=true,ignore_mods=true,non_consuming=true,description="Nacre:finish-panel-or-window-drag"})
", "hypr/conf/cursor.lua": "-- Generated by tools/generate_compositor_config.py; edit compositor-contract.json.
-- UWSM owns the cursor preference; apply its values once when Hyprland starts.
local function apply_session_cursor()
    local theme = os.getenv("XCURSOR_THEME")
    local size = math.tointeger(tonumber(os.getenv("XCURSOR_SIZE") or ""))
    if not theme or theme == "" or not size or size < 1 or size > 2147483647 then
        return
    end

    local argument = "'" .. theme:gsub("'", "'\\''") .. "'"
    hl.exec_cmd("hyprctl setcursor " .. argument .. " " .. tostring(size))
end
hl.on("hyprland.start", apply_session_cursor)
